hero.eyebrow: For homeowners in Reno, Tahoe, and Truckee
hero.h1: Lighting Design for Your Nevada Home
hero.sub: Lighting has the power to shape how your home looks and feels. Our lighting design services bring intention, comfort, and performance to every space.

items.p: One press sets the room. Welcome Home, Movie Night, and Goodnight scenes from a keypad on the wall, each light at the level you chose.
Lights follow your schedule, dim at sunset, and answer a voice command. Away from home, your phone runs the house.
Tunable white light shifts from cool in the morning to warm at night, the way daylight does. It keeps your body clock on track and helps you wind down.

about.h2: Built on performance and integrity since 2002
about.p: Keith Burrowes founded Sierra Integrated Systems in 2002 to design and install lighting control and home technology for high-end homes. One team designs, installs, and supports your system, and works with you, your architect, builder, and designer to make your vision come to life.
about.alt: Keith Burrowes, founder of Sierra Integrated Systems

items.p: We were very fortunate to work with Ashley Shores at Sierra Integrated Systems. The quality of work in installing a surround sound system in our home was exceptional. Ashley and Shawn were extremely professional, knowledgeable, and informative and the other staff was amazing as well.

We selected Sierra Integrated Systems to do a complete furnish and installation of lighting controls and automated window shades on a new custom home. They are very good to deal with and really know their products.

Ryan and his team are the best. They are very professional, extremely responsive, very easy to work with and great on follow up. I would recommend their work to anyone, for A/V, lighting, security. Excellence is achieved only with hard work, and they have.

process.eyebrow: We work with architects, builders, and designers

steps.p: We begin with a lighting design consultation to understand your home, lifestyle, and goals: plans, room usage, aesthetic preferences, and any smart home integration needs.
A lighting concept that balances function, atmosphere, and architectural intent. Fixture types, layering, and control approaches are outlined for each space.
Fixture placement, beam spreads, control zones, and performance requirements, so builders and electricians have clarity.
We support the installation and fine-tune lighting scenes, dimming, and controls for a polished final result.

items.q: Do I really need a lighting designer if I already have an electrician or architect?
items.a: Electricians and architects play important roles, but a lighting design specialist focuses specifically on light quality, layering, and performance to enhance the final experience.

items.q: Can you work from my existing blueprints or during a remodel?
items.a: Yes. We regularly design lighting for both new construction and remodels using existing plans.

items.q: How long does the lighting design process usually take?
items.a: Timelines vary by project size, but most lighting design services align with the early planning and construction phases.

items.q: Can you work with fixtures I've already purchased?
items.a: When possible, we can incorporate existing fixtures while ensuring compatibility and performance.

items.q: Will the lighting system be easy for my family to use?
items.a: Absolutely. We design lighting controls to be intuitive, with simple keypads, scenes, and app-based access.
We provide lighting design services throughout Reno, Tahoe, Truckee, Carson City, Incline Village, Crystal Bay, and other surrounding areas of Nevada.

services.p: One team for lighting, shades, audio, video, and the wiring behind them.

items.p: Rich multi-room audio and crisp video distribution tailored to every space in your residence.
A custom private cinema with high-performance sound and high-definition displays.
Lutron motorized shades that adjust to changing sunlight or your daily schedule.
Custom touchscreens and keypads, with mobile control from your phone.
Scenes like Welcome Home, Movie Night, or Goodnight, from wall keypads or your phone.
Complete electrical wiring, backup generators, and low-voltage wiring under one roof.

final.p: Tell us about your home and pick a time.
